nicgiprep

nicgiprep is a neuroimaging preprocessing pipeline for longitudinal and multimodal MRI data, built around the USLR (Unified Segmentation-based Longitudinal Registration) framework. It provides BIDS-compatible processing for cross-sectional, longitudinal, and multimodal studies using SynthSeg and SynthMorph for segmentation and registration.

Note

This project is under active development.
